user.title: Add a Nuimo Control
user.description: Enter the Nuimo's Bluetooth address. Usually you won't need this: Home Assistant finds a Nuimo by itself when it's nearby and awake.

error.invalid_address: That isn't a Bluetooth address (it looks like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
error.not_found: No Nuimo with that address is in range. Wake it up and bring it closer to a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

one_picture.message: Give exactly one of icon, matrix, number or level (got: {given}).

not_a_nuimo.message: Device {device_id} isn't a Nuimo that's set up.

not_connected.message: The Nuimo ({address}) isn't connected right now. Touch it to wake it.

show.name: Show on the Nuimo
show.description: Lights up the Nuimo's 9×9 LEDs with an icon, your own picture, a number or a level bar.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: A built-in picture. Use one of icon, picture, number or level.

matrix.name: Picture
matrix.description: Nine rows of nine characters: . or space is off, anything else is on.

level.name: Level
level.description: A bar filling from the bottom, e.g. a light's brightness.

duration.name: Show for
duration.description: How long the picture stays on (up to 25.5 seconds).

fade.name: Fade
fade.description: Fade from the previous picture instead of switching at once.
